mentions.name: ZenPocket
mentions.description: This iOS app is a minimalist mindfulness tool with three parts: a simple Zazen (sitting meditation) timer, Zen readings, and an AI Zen teacher chat where users can ask anything from Buddhist teachings to handling personal problems. It deliberately sends no notifications, aiming for a simple, clean, non-notification-driven experience that helps keep the mind stable.
mentions.problem: The builder was tired of notification-driven apps and wanted something simple and clean; meditation, readings, and an AI teacher help with stressful problems and mental stability.
